t_camper_13: The sergeant gave Jakub "Shadow" Camper a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 4 or any other.
Jakub "Shadow" Camper agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F3 and grazed Jakub "Shadow" Camper's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer of the Hegemony (@w0lfer2210).
vic_jul11: Gustav "Tin" Jul found a place in S-F10 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
One of the first hundred, Gustav "Tin" Jul was given the First Wave ribbon. He wrapped the accompanying paper against the damp.
Gustav "Tin" Jul's transfer to the role of chaplain was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.
The sky stayed clear above S-F10. Gustav "Tin" Jul watched a small cloud form and quietly hoped it would bring friends.
A football came over the parapet from the Concord side with Anselm "Parson" Rock's name scratched on it. Gustav "Tin" Jul kicked it back. It did not come again.

A shouted challenge from Yann Vee (Concord) reached Gustav "Tin" Jul (Hegemony) at the Drowned Farm. The answer was lost beneath the guns. The challenge was not repeated. The Concord took Verdel Ridge. Gustav "Tin" Jul watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
The guns found S-F10. Gustav "Tin" Jul was dug out of a collapsed dugout with both legs pinned and carried back on a groundsheet.
No bed for Gustav "Tin" Jul yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up.

Gustav "Tin" Jul lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gustav "Tin" Jul. Gustav "Tin" Jul read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
